name: eSports Platform
description: I co-founded an eSports startup focused on building a competitive matchmaking platform where CS2 players can monetize their in-game skills. I led the front-end development, designed the UI/UX, and managed API integrations to ensure a seamless user experience. I also supported backend development, handled administrative operations, and developed the Electron.js desktop client used by our AI-powered anti-cheat system.

name: Automated Archiving
description: I developed a Python automation script that handled the digital archiving of an company's physical documents. Using OCR, the system extracted text from scanned files, identified key information, and automatically renamed and categorized each document based on predefined rules. Once processed, the documents were uploaded and organized within the company’s cloud storage, creating a fully automated and reliable archiving workflow.

name: Uber but for Bus
description: I developed a school project inspired by the Uber model but designed for bus transportation. Created for a competition organized by the Chamber of Commerce—where it achieved second place—the platform allowed users to track bus locations in real time, purchase tickets online, and interact with a simple JavaScript-based assistant that queried the database to suggest the best route. As the project had no budget, I built a functional demo focusing on the core features. I handled the entire development process, including front-end, back-end, and UI/UX design.

name: Cryprto Ecommerce
description: I’ve always been passionate about emerging technologies and the DeFi ecosystem, so I set out to explore its potential by developing a crypto-based eCommerce concept. The idea was to allow users to purchase products directly in cryptocurrency, without relying on fiat at any point. For this project, I built only the core portion of the platform needed to run an initial smoke test and gauge user interest. I handled every aspect of the prototype — front-end, back-end, and UI/UX design — creating a functional preview of how decentralized payments could seamlessly integrate into an online shopping experience.

name: Personal Portfolio
description: I built my personal portfolio as a way to showcase my projects while improving my skills with TailwindCSS. The website reflects my style and workflow, and served as a hands-on opportunity to deepen my understanding of modern utility-first design and responsive front-end development.
